headline: Pre-book timed tickets to cross the historic rope bridge
reservation: It is essential to pre-book your visit in advance to cross the Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge. Access to the bridge itself requires a specific timed entry ticket, while the coastal path and tearoom are subject to separate National Trust management; always verify current winter operations via official channels.

days.title: Coastal Heights and Rope Crossings

stops.name: Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge
stops.detail: Cross the 30-meter high bridge to the small island of Carrick-a-Rede to experience the traditional salmon fisherman's site.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 minutes from nearby towns; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: Pace your visit to account for the walk from the car park to the bridge; dogs are welcome on leads but cannot cross the bridge.

intel.title: Bridge Restrictions
intel.text: Dogs are strictly prohibited from crossing the rope bridge but are welcome on leads in the surrounding outdoor areas and the Weighbridge Tearoom. Evidence indicates visitors must check seasonal winter updates for specific site accessibility.

intel.title: Winter Operations
intel.text: Site accessibility and crossing availability may change during the winter months. Consult the National Trust for specific opening details before traveling to the North Antrim coast.

intel.title: Arrival Facilities
intel.text: Evidence regarding specific parking capacity is not provided; visitors should arrive according to their pre-booked time slot. A tearoom is available on-site for facilities.

intel.title: Local Supplies
intel.text: Specific fuel locations near the site are not documented in the provided sources. Verify fuel and charging availability in gateway towns like Ballycastle or Bushmills before departure.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Cellular signal strength at the cliff edge and bridge site is not verified by official sources. Download your digital tickets or booking confirmations before leaving nearby towns.

plan.arrival: Collect your rental in Belfast or Derry and proceed to the North Antrim coast. Check into local accommodation in Ballycastle before arriving for your pre-booked crossing time.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the paved coastal roads; check local rental agreements for restrictions on narrow rural routes.
plan.goldenHour: The coastal cliffs offer dramatic lighting, though specific sunset viewpoints should be balanced with site closing times.
